title: Cities ranked by deposits
statementMd:
Total deposits per customer city, biggest first, rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `city`, `deposits`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(t.amount), 2) AS deposits FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE t.kind = 'deposit' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY deposits DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
